title: Compose database queries over tuple-valued projections
goal: Keep tuple constructor keys usable in later grouping, filtering and joins; retain anonymous keys on EF10.

selectionNotes: Actual SQLite execution: ValueTuple/Tuple grouped keys, ValueTuple joined key, one-element arity and nested Rest. EF10 rejects these shapes; anonymous grouped key works. Arbitrary record constructors, all tuple arities, other providers and GA are excluded.
